title: Zesty Glassy Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A low sodium Venezuelan dish featuring makrut lime leaves and tandoor style chicken, served with a glassy jelly sauce.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine makrut lime leaves, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, tandoor spice mix, and salt free seasoning, and blend until smooth.
Place the chicken pieces in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, tossing to coat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the tandoor or oven and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the chicken is cooking, combine 1 cup of water and 1 tablespoon of unflavored gelatin in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and let cool.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush the glassy jelly sauce over the top of each skewer.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with additional makrut lime leaves if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
